newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanians get second shot in mass polio blitz.
newsitem.headline: Albanians get second shot in mass polio blitz.

text.p: Albania's health authorities on Monday launched the second stage of a mass polio immunisation programme to end an outbreak which has claimed 14 lives since April.
"We will manage to eliminate the circulation of the...virus by the end of this campaign," Ibrahim Luloci, head of the national coordination vaccine programme, told Reuters.

The second vaccine with booster doses will reinforce the first dose dispensed in October and give Albanians life-long immunity from the disease, which has killed 14 people and infected 137, Luloci said.
Albania launched the immunisation campaign in October with the aid of international organisations.
